![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14198128/assets/635de7075b0d106ffc2a0f15e65ca7a3406a49945591aa5eae59090c74df1398.png)

Due to the symmetry of the student's $t$-distribution, we have that $P(|X|\ge x)=0.01$ is equivalent to

$$
2P(X\ge x)=0.01\,⟹\,P(X\ge x)=0.005.
$$

Now, since $X∼{T}_{25},$ we focus on the row of the table that corresponds to $k=25.$

| $k∖p$ | $0.100$ | $0.050$ | $0.025$ | $0.010$ | $0.005$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $24$ | $1.318$ | $1.711$ | $2.064$ | $2.492$ | $2.797$ |
| $25$ | $1.316$ | $1.708$ | $2.060$ | $2.485$ | $2.787$ |
| $26$ | $1.315$ | $1.706$ | $2.056$ | $2.479$ | $2.779$ |

From this row, we see that

$$
P(X\ge 2.787)=0.005.
$$

Therefore, our answer is $x=2.787.$
